data.rationale: The proposal captures the right goal, parameters (dish, servings) and step order, but it is vague: it doesn't say to set servings on the recipe page, to take exactly the first three ingredients, or to click "New note" and use the note format, and it doesn't mention switching tabs or opening the first rated recipe, so a browser automation couldn't be built from the spec alone.
